speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of AIDS, I need to assess your immune status; what is your most recent CD4 count? Have you noticed any floaters, flashes of light, or a curtain coming down over your vision in the right eye?

speaker: Patient
text: 34-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of decreased vision and seeing black spots in the right eye. He reports no pain, and the left eye is asymptomatic. He mentions being treated for fungal esophagitis 6 months ago and was diagnosed with Kaposi's sarcoma 2 years ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: Your CD4 count is likely very low given the history of esophageal candidiasis and Kaposi's sarcoma. To distinguish between retinitis and other causes, do you experience any pain with eye movement or photophobia?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Decreased vision and black spots in the right eye. I also have No pain, Left eye is asymptomatic.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your advanced AIDS and the painless onset of visual disturbances, I strongly suspect Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis. REQUEST TEST: Fluorescein Angiography.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal fluorescein angiography makes CMV retinitis less likely, so I need to visualize the retina directly. REQUEST TEST: Dilated Fundus Examination.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Granular yellow-white opacities around the retinal vessels and multiple areas of dot-blot hemorrhages

speaker: Doctor
text: The fundus findings of granular yellow-white opacities and dot-blot hemorrhages are classic for CMV retinitis, despite the earlier angiography result. I will confirm the diagnosis with specific imaging. REQUEST IMAGES

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: AIDS, fungal esophagitis treated with fluconazole, Kaposi's sarcoma Social history: No additional information provided

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of your AIDS history, painless vision loss, and the classic "pizza pie" appearance of hemorrhages and opacities confirms the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis
